method: Crosswalk of captured HTML/source findings, official UI documentation and candidate graph nodes; none supplies verified live internal behavior.
privacy: Only source evidence IDs, public action references and human-authored questions. No copied chat content, account identifiers, payloads or routes.

capabilities.label: Select a conversation
capabilities.next_experiment: Which UI state and route shape change when a synthetic conversation is selected?

capabilities.label: Edit and submit a draft
capabilities.next_experiment: When does a submitted draft become a durable message, and how is the pending attempt represented?

capabilities.label: Receive and complete a response
capabilities.next_experiment: What observable sequence distinguishes partial output, completion and failed generation?

capabilities.label: Stop and retry a response
capabilities.next_experiment: Does stopping preserve a partial message, and what new state or attempt follows retry?

capabilities.label: Edit a previous message
capabilities.next_experiment: Does editing replace the original, preserve alternatives or create a new selected path?

capabilities.label: Regenerate an assistant response
capabilities.next_experiment: Are previous responses retained, and how are response attempts connected to visible messages?

capabilities.label: Branch from a message into a new chat
capabilities.next_experiment: Does branching create separate conversation identity, copy prefix nodes or reference shared ancestry?

capabilities.label: Pin a conversation
capabilities.next_experiment: Which generic state change indicates a pinned chat, and is it persistent across reload?
